Title: cpgdirection lookup_blood_hg19
Description: Blood catalogue lookup: 1,970,053 CpG-gene pairs (668,711 CpGs, hg19) with predicted methylation-expression direction, calibrated probability, confidence and evidence tier; one Ensembl gene per name at a strand-aware hg19 TSS, models retrained on harmonized pools (rebuilt in 0.99.7)

Title: cpgdirection lookup_nasal_epithelium_hg19
Description: Nasal epithelium catalogue lookup: 1,500,942 CpG-gene pairs (552,167 CpGs, hg19; rebuilt in 0.99.7)

Title: cpgdirection lookup_solid_tissue_hg19
Description: Solid tissue catalogue lookup: 1,184,630 CpG-gene pairs (541,536 CpGs, hg19; rebuilt in 0.99.7)

Title: cpgdirection smr_directions
Description: Two-sample SMR causal directions (GoDMC mQTL x eQTLGen cis-eQTL, blood): 413,982 CpG-gene pairs with tier, p_SMR, instruments and HEIDI results

Title: cpgdirection cpg_positions_hg19
Description: EPIC v2 probe positions lifted to hg19: 930,178 probes

Title: cpgdirection brain_directions
Description: Brain SMR causal directions (Brain-mMeta x BrainMeta v2): 220,383 CpG-gene pairs with tier and score

Title: cpgdirection saliva_bridge_scores
Description: Genome-wide synthesised saliva-bridge scores (periphery-to-brain concordance ensemble percentiles)

Title: cpgdirection epicv2_probe_gene_annotation
Description: Multi-source EPIC v2 probe-to-gene annotation: 1,006,212 CpG-gene pairs (793,233 CpGs) as the union of five annotation tracks (Illumina UCSC RefGene, Illumina GencodeV41, Zhou GENCODE v41, Exeter GENCODE 49 (re-annotated manifest v3.0), Exeter regulatory elements) with per-track support flags, agreement counts and the Exeter Promoter_2000bp/Enhancer_5000bp labels

Title: cpgdirection distal_links
Description: Distal CpG-to-gene links: ENCODE-rE2G thresholded enhancer-gene predictions (Gschwind et al. 2026) for 26 resting blood cell types and brain regions/cell types (47 released ENCODE annotation sets) plus scE2G single-cell enhancer-gene predictions (Sheth et al. 2026) for nine PBMC cell types at E2G.Score.qnorm >= 0.177, all intersected with EPIC v2 probe positions (hg38) and keyed on the cg identifier: 10,205,122 rows, 1,289,742 CpG-gene pairs (525,222 CpGs); one row per CpG x gene x source x biosample with the source score and a tissue class (blood/brain). A link proposes a target and carries no direction

Title: cpgdirection onco_eqtm_consensus
Description: Onco-eQTM cross-tumour cis-eQTM consensus (Korra et al. 2026; 27 TCGA cancer types, 450K, hg19): 2,464,990 CpG-gene pairs with consensus direction, agreement tier (O1 >= 5 cancers agreeing: 113,560; O2 2-4 agreeing; O3 disagreeing; O4 single cancer), number of cancer types and correlation summaries recovered from the t statistics. Reported beside, never inside, the peripheral direction call

Title: cpgdirection smr_directions_v2
Description: Two-sample SMR causal directions in blood, second layer (GoDMC mQTL instruments x three expression outcomes: eQTLGen cis-eQTL, FinnGen immune-multiome PBMC and cell types, INTERVAL blood RNA-seq): 768,862 CpG-gene pairs (133,498 CpGs), each with its per-outcome records, a replication rung (replicated 108,135; high 14,284; moderate 528,204; weak 52,878; reported 65,361) and a per-pair accuracy from a leave-one-chromosome-out model against measured blood eQTMs. Read by cpgdirection >= 1.1.0; the resource smr_directions, read by cpgdirection 0.99.x and 1.0.x, is unchanged

Title: cpgdirection cpg_coordinates
Description: Probe coordinates and array membership for every probe ID of the Illumina HM27, 450K, EPIC v1 and EPIC v2 methylation arrays (1,084,297 IDs): the arrays carrying each probe; an hg38 position from the Zhou-lab InfiniumAnnotation (SeSAMe) manifests and an hg19 position from the Illumina 450K manifest or the EPIC v1 coordinates, each stored only where epicv2_probe_gene_annotation (hg38) or cpg_positions_hg19 does not already give it (352,454 hg38 and 141,945 hg19 positions), and a flag for 1,094 probes that two sources place differently in hg38. Read by cpgd_cpg_annotation() in cpgdirection
